AURORAMOD-HEAT_DISSIPATION_CORE.title: Heat Dissipation Core
AURORAMOD-HEAT_DISSIPATION_CORE.flavor: On the day they sealed her away, it was the only part still humming.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_DISSIPATION_CORE.descript: End of turn: Cold — gain 5 Block; Warm — gain 3 Block and deal 3 damage to a random enemy; Overload — deal 6 damage to a random enemy.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_DISSIPATION_CORE_PLUS.fla: The Ancients gave it a turn, and it remembered it was born a weapon.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_DISSIPATION_CORE_PLUS.des: End of turn: Cold — gain 7 Block; Warm — gain 4 Block and deal 4 damage to a random enemy; Overload — deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
AURORAMOD-PULSE_METRONOME.title: Pulse Metronome
AURORAMOD-PULSE_METRONOME.flavor: On the third beat, armor locks. On the fourth, the reactor climbs.
AURORAMOD-PULSE_METRONOME.description: Whenever you become Chained, gain 5 Block, then gain 1 Heat.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_LINED_SCABBARD.title: Heat-Lined Scabbard
AURORAMOD-HEAT_LINED_SCABBARD.flavor: The blade remains sheathed. The core already remembers the swing.
AURORAMOD-HEAT_LINED_SCABBARD.descriptio: At the start of your first turn, gain 4 Momentum and 4 Heat.
AURORAMOD-FULL_LOAD_COUPLER.title: Full-Load Coupler
AURORAMOD-FULL_LOAD_COUPLER.flavor: The war begins again only when every hardpoint is lit.
AURORAMOD-FULL_LOAD_COUPLER.description: First time each combat you fill all Module slots: every Module gains 2 Enhancement and triggers once, then gain 3 Heat. The filling deployment can also trigger Sentry Array.
AURORAMOD-LIMIT_BREAK_REACTOR.title: Limit-Break Reactor
AURORAMOD-LIMIT_BREAK_REACTOR.flavor: Cooling is only the interval before the next failure.
AURORAMOD-LIMIT_BREAK_REACTOR.descriptio: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Energy. At the end of each turn, gain 2 Heat before Overheat resolves.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_ATTACK_MODULE_R: The assembly line still thinks the war never ended.
At the start of your first turn next combat: Deploy an Attack Module, then consume this relic.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_SHIELD_MODULE_R: For once, what they gave you was not made to kill.
At the start of your first turn next combat: Deploy a Shield Module, then consume this relic.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_HEAT11_RELIC.fl: The core crosses the redline; every flaw burns into a new answer.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_HEAT11_RELIC.de: At the start of your first turn next combat: gain 11 Heat, then consume this relic.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_MOMENTUM4_RELIC: That single strike only needs to land once.
At the start of your first turn next combat: gain 4 Momentum, then consume this relic.
AURORAMOD-AURORA_PRELOAD_CHAIN_DRAW_RELI: A thousand voices, waiting again for your next command.
At the start of your first turn next combat: draw 2 extra cards and gain 2 Heat, then consume this relic.
